tests.name: raw_event_duplicates
tests.checks: Raw analytics events with a repeated event_id (SDK retries). Expected; staging keeps the first copy.

tests.name: stg_event_id_unique
tests.checks: After deduplication every event_id appears once.

tests.name: assignment_unique_and_valid
tests.checks: One assignment per customer, a known variant and platform, and an assignment time inside the test window.

tests.name: customers_match_assignments
tests.checks: Every assigned customer has exactly one CRM row and the reverse.

tests.name: payment_attempts_valid
tests.checks: Known outcome and method, positive amount, and a decline code exactly when declined.

tests.name: activity_belongs_to_assigned_customers
tests.checks: No event or payment from a customer the assignment service never bucketed.

tests.name: activity_after_assignment
tests.checks: Nothing happens before the customer was bucketed or after the test closed (one hour of grace for sessions in flight).

tests.name: one_customer_per_session
tests.checks: A session_id never appears under two customers across the two sources.

tests.name: refunds_and_disputes_reference_orders
tests.checks: Refunds and disputes point at authorized attempts, never exceed the order, and disputes fall on or before the data cutoff.

tests.name: no_control_contamination
tests.checks: Control customers never saw the express button or paid with it.

tests.name: payment_sessions_have_client_event
tests.checks: Every session that reached the payments ledger also has a client checkout_started event.

tests.name: srm_assignment
tests.checks: Bucketing split is 50/50 across all assigned customers (chi-square, p < 0.001 fails).

tests.name: srm_exposed
tests.checks: The exposed population (customers with a logged checkout_started) is still 50/50.

tests.name: srm_exposed_by_build
tests.checks: Within each platform and app build, the exposed population is 50/50 (finds where an SRM comes from).

tests.name: srm_analysis_population
tests.checks: After excluding the faulty build (a pre-treatment attribute, so both arms lose the same kind of customer), the split is 50/50 again.
